WarmVerticalFlip8.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster vertically flipped into an independent owned raster at the same dimensions/depth. Complete public FlipVertical, admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg vflip graph produces a negative-stride view, then public frame allocation/copy materializes every output row inside each operation before releasing view/output. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly. Exact row placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original whole raster is measured.

WarmVerticalFlip8.method: Twelve fixed adjacent managed/native pairs with alternating order and the declared fixed batch of complete operations per subject. All pairs retained. Twelve native batches before and after. The conservative bound includes paired log-ratio confidence and every all-actual/upper-outlier-diagnostic managed-mean confidence against the faster before/paired/after native bracket. Native worker excludes IPC; managed includes complete original public benchmark method, output creation/growth/ownership/disposal and delegate dispatch. Setup, fixture decode, JIT and validation excluded equally; native documented wrappers/input/scratch retained. No timing or baseline-setting changes in production.
